item.title: No Grid, No Glory: What History Teaches Us About the Next Major War
item.description: We cannot win 21st-Century conflicts with a 20th-Century electric grid. The Trump Administration’s new National Security Strategy goes to great lengths to do what every good strategist is taught: align means and ends in a coherent and credible way.
